cli.setupHelp:
Proton Pass CLI setup

Usage:
  proton-pass-mcp setup [--force] [--install-dir <directory>]

Options:
  --force                    Reinstall the stable CLI even if one already exists
  --install-dir <directory>  Specify the CLI install directory
  -h, --help                 Show this help
cli.mainHelp:
Proton Pass MCP

Usage:
  proton-pass-mcp              Start the MCP server over stdio
  proton-pass-mcp setup        Safely install the official Proton Pass CLI
  proton-pass-mcp setup --help Show the setup options
server.invalidAccessPolicy: PROTON_PASS_ACCESS_POLICY is invalid. Check the local access policy.
server.invalidHandoffConfig: The temporary file settings are invalid. Check PROTON_PASS_HANDOFF_DIR and PROTON_PASS_HANDOFF_TTL_SECONDS.
server.handoffShutdownFailed: Failed to reclaim temporary files at shutdown. Check the cleanup on the next start.
setup.noLocalAppData: LOCALAPPDATA is not set, so the default install directory cannot be determined.
setup.invalidCliPath: PASS_CLI_PATH does not point to a valid Proton Pass CLI executable. Fix the value, or remove the variable to use auto-detection.
setup.unsupportedPlatform: The Proton Pass CLI is not supported on this environment ({platform}/{arch}).

setup.noAssetForPlatform: The Proton Pass CLI manifest has no build for this environment.
